bio: Mark Andrew Tedford (born June 26, 1969) is an American politician and insurance agent who is the Oklahoma House of Representatives member from the 69th district. He represents Jenks and South Tulsa.
offices: Member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives (2022–present)
